Times of Israel, 15 Oct 2026, 5:12pm Israel time (15:12 BST). Curl blocked; content via WebFetch summary.

Headline: Hezbollah claims confiscated truck of explosives, but denies assassination plans
- 780kg (1,720lb) of explosives incl. 250kg TNT and 250kg C-4, seized at checkpoint on main highway linking Beirut with eastern Beqaa Valley; two men detained; Lebanese probe launched.
- Hassan Fadlallah (Hezbollah MP): explosives "intended exclusively for use against the Israeli occupation"; assassination allegations "baseless"; "It is well known that [Hezbollah's] weapons include explosive devices — a subject the enemy has frequently addressed and whose impact it deeply fears"
- PM Nawaf Salam: C-4 used in several "infamous political assassinations in Lebanon's modern history"
